note: PROD-008: Express handlers under a crmProxies prefix. The proxy is registered first, so these never run in dev; production never reaches Express at all. Each is either dead code to delete or behaviour to port into the edge function and then delete. This list only shrinks — the one exception was PROD-008b teaching the scanner to see prefix-mounted routers, which added 131 handlers it had never been able to match. That was a measurement correction, not a regression. DETECTION FIX 2026-08-22: the backlog GREW 8 -> 114, which is not a regression. Routers imported through the server/domains/* BARRELS (export { default as x } from '../routes/y') resolved to the barrel file, which contains no router.get() calls, so every router mounted that way was invisible to this gate. The scanner now follows a re-export one level. All 106 newly-surfaced handlers sit under prefixes confirmed present in crmProxies with a matching supabase/functions/ directory, in 8 files: routes/billing.ts (33), routes-customer-portal.ts (25), routes-knowledge-base.ts (16), routes-ai-gpt5.ts (9), routes/article-ratings-routes.ts (7), routes/reading-history-routes.ts (6), routes/article-bookmarks-routes.ts (6), routes-enhanced-service.ts (4). Same class of miss as the earlier prefix-mount gap, which had hidden 131.

retained.POST /api/business-records/import (serve: LIVE BROKEN FEATURE, retained because deleting it would destroy the only implementation. POST /api/business-records/import is the lead CSV import: multer upload, parseCSV, per-row dedup against existing records, insert, behind enforceUsageLimits. client/src/components/leads/LeadsImport.tsx calls it, and the business-records edge function has NO import branch — so lead CSV import already 404s in dev and production. Porting it needs multipart handling (the EDGE-002l fix covers it, and _shared/catalog-import-runner.ts is the precedent), a CSV parser, the dedup pass, and an edge equivalent of enforceUsageLimits, which does not exist. That is a feature story. PROD-008b.
